exact_statement:
theorem no_polynomial_removal_bound :
    ∀ c C : ℝ, 0 < c → 0 < C →
  ∃ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n ∧
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε < 1 ∧
      ∃ A : BinaryMatrix n,
        fixedDistance A ≥ ε ∧
        (copyCount fixedH A : ℝ) <
          c * Real.rpow ε C * ((n : ℝ) ^ 132)
